title: Must-do experience in Barcelona!
text: We had the best time exploring the Gothic Quarter. Our photographer, Ale is so talented and super helpful with posing (which we definitely needed!). We spent the whole session laughing and having fun. He showed us some stunning hidden spots we never would have found on our own. If you want beautiful memories and a great time, you have to book this!
